Runs open-source and official models by API: images, video, audio and language.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [replicate.com](https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens)
- **Setting:** `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [replicate.com](https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Replicate and open [replicate.com](https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** An API token from Replicate's API tokens page; the Gateway sends it as a bearer token. Apps POST to /v1/models/\{owner\}/\{name\}/predictions or /v1/predictions with Prefer: wait (up to 60 seconds), or pass a webhook URL for longer runs.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Replicate) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  replicate: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show replicate` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.replicate.com/v1/account` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** 600 a minute. Creating predictions 600 a minute; every other endpoint 3,000 a minute.
